Is Online Gambling Legal in Canada?

In Canada, online gambling is legal, but it’s regulated by provincial governments. Depending on your region, the list of top Canadian online casinos will be different. As you play with provincially licensed operators, your activity will be entirely within the boundaries of the law.

Many offshore sites offer their services as top online casinos for Canadian players. Although playing at offshore casinos isn't clearly defined by law, you should know that local laws will still apply when placing bets with operators headquartered outside the country.

How Gambling Is Regulated by Province

Each province in Canada is responsible for its gambling laws, requiring online casino operators to obtain separate casino licences for each province where they wish to operate.

Knowing which regulator issues licences in your province is important so that you can check if the casino is legit or to know who to contact if you need assistance after you’ve exhausted your options. Here are dedicated regulators for Canadian casinos by province:

Alcohol and Gaming Commission of Ontario
Alberta Gaming and Liquor Commission
British Columbia Gaming Policy and Enforcement Branch
Kahnawake Gaming Commission
Manitoba Gaming Control Commission
Nova Scotia Alcohol and Gaming Authority
Quebec Commission for Alcohol, Racing and Games
Saskatchewan Liquor and Gaming Authority

💡 AskGamblers tip: The rules are different in each Canadian province, so you may not find the same games and betting options in all of them. For instance, while online sports betting is available in virtually all provinces, online slots may not be.

Legal Gambling Age in Canada

Keep in mind that when gambling online at Canada casinos, you must be of legal gambling age, which again, differs by province. In Alberta, Ontario, and Quebec, you must be at least 19 years old to gamble, whereas in British Columbia, the minimum age is 18.

How AskGamblers Reviews and Rates Canadian Online Casinos

Before you choose your favourite online casino in Canada, you should know more about our casino review process. 

The reason you can trust AskGamblers reviews is because of our CasinoRank, an unbiased algorithm which assesses online casinos. Additionally, our casino experts go through the casino and test different things to compose a detailed review, and all of these things are listed below: 

Security – we know security is one of the players' top priorities, so we routinely verify valid licences and SSL certificates.
Games variety – apart from listing software providers, we take a large portion of games for a test ride and see if they work in both demo mode and when you play for real money.
Bonuses and promotions – from welcome bonuses to loyalty schemes, we look into the nitty-gritty of casino bonuses, ensuring bonus Terms and Conditions are fair.
Payments – reputable Canada gambling sites commonly offer a broad selection of secure payment methods. Our job is to ensure the banking options are indeed available and that the casino respects the stated payout speed.
Customer support - an online casino is nothing without excellent and knowledgeable customer service. The availability of different support avenues, such as live chat, email, and telephone, should align with the casino's claims.
Mobile – mobile optimisation is a must, especially if there’s no dedicated casino app. Our task is to confirm that the casino runs smoothly on different mobile devices and operating systems.
Responsible gambling – all Canadian casinos must adhere to strict responsible gambling policies and we check for tools such as deposit and other limits, self-exclusion process, breaks, etc.

FAQ
Is it safe to gamble at an online casino in Canada?

Yes, online gambling in Canada is completely safe as long as you place your wagers at licensed casinos. Depending on the province, players have different choices of casino and sportsbook operators, so stick to the ones that have a gambling permit in your province.
